days.title: Arrival in London
days.desc: Welcome to London, a city with a rich history and vibrant culture. You'll be transferred to your hotel upon arrival. Spend the rest of the day exploring the city. If you're into shopping, Oxford Street and Harrods are must-visit spots.

days.title: London
days.desc: Immerse yourself in London's splendour using the one-day Hop on Hop off Pass, inclusive of a one-way Thames River cruise. Experience the city's highlights at your pace. Overnight in London. Optional: London Eye standard tickets

days.title: London
days.desc: Following breakfast, relish the freedom to explore the capital city independently or opt for an excursion to discover the surrounding areas. Overnight in London. Optional: Stonehenge and Bath full day group tour

days.title: London – Glasgow
days.desc: Post breakfast, proceed to check out and board your train to Glasgow. Upon arrival, independently reach your hotel. Glasgow beckons with its vibrant cultural scene and exceptional dining choices. Check in and relish the remaining day at your own pace.

days.title: Glasgow – Inverness
days.desc: Following breakfast, gather your belongings and head to Glasgow Railway Station for your train journey to Inverness. Arriving in the heart of the Scottish Highlands, Inverness boasts breathtaking beauty and cosmopolitan allure. Check in and savour the day at your leisure. Overnight in Inverness. Optional: Glasgow 1 day hop on hop off pass

days.title: Inverness
days.desc: Immerse yourself in the enchanting beauty of Inverness. Embark on an exploration to The Isle of Skye & Eilean Donan Castle. Discover the wonders of this picturesque location.

days.title: Inverness – Edinburgh
days.desc: Post-breakfast, proceed to check out and make your way to the railway station for your journey to Edinburgh. Arriving in the capital, check in at the hotel. Welcome to Edinburgh, a city adorned with rich history and celebrated for its harmonious fusion of antiquity and modernity. Indulge in remarkable dining experiences and diverse activities in this acclaimed city.

days.title: Edinburgh
days.desc: Immerse yourself in the vibrant atmosphere of Edinburgh, exploring at your leisure. Experience the city's unique charm and cultural offerings. Overnight in Edinburgh. Optional: Edinburgh 1 day hop on hop off pass Edinburgh | Loch Lomond, Stirling Castle, 10 -hour coach tour

days.title: Departure
days.desc: Following breakfast, check out from your accommodation and depart via private transfer to Edinburgh Airport for your onward journey. Unit 11-12 Turnham Green Terrace Mews, London W4 1QU. about.title: Best season
about.body: May–September for long days; shoulder months quieter and better value

about.title: Weather
about.body: Mild and changeable. 12–20°C in summer. Pack a rain layer year-round

goodToKnow.title: Best season
goodToKnow.body: April–September for long days and best weather; shoulder months quieter and often better value.

goodToKnow.title: Currency & documents
goodToKnow.body: England/Scotland use £ GBP. Ireland uses € EUR. Both are Schengen-free — check your entry requirements.

goodToKnow.title: What to pack
goodToKnow.body: Layers and a waterproof in any month. Comfortable shoes for cobbles and coastal paths.

goodToKnow.title: Rail travel
goodToKnow.body: Seat reservations are included on inter-city trains. Arrive 10 minutes before departure.

terms: All rates are net and per person for the package.

Child rates apply for children aged from 2 to 11 years old. 1 child sharing a room with 2 adults (depending on hotel policy). If the hotel doesn’t have availability for family rooms, adult rates will apply.
All rates are subject to availability at the time of booking. Europe Incoming will endeavour to match the rates quoted in the packages.
Rates quoted are not applicable during trade fair periods, major European Holidays and other major events.
City taxes are not included in the price.
If certain entrances are closed during certain periods, alternative entrances will be provided.
All bookings must be confirmed at least 60 working days prior to arrival date by the Agent. Early bookings increase the chances of achieving the quoted package rate.
The prices we quote are indicative, but we always try to confirm the prices offered in this document.
We require 100% pre-payment either by bank transfer or by credit card (VISA or Mastercard). All charges for bank transfers need to be covered by the Agent.
Vouchers will be issued after receipt of the full payment in our bank account.
